beats.text: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

beats.text: His disciples had watched him pray for years, and watched him come back from it different. So one morning they asked him for the thing they wanted most. Teach us how to do that.

beats.text: He taught them to walk up to God and call him Father. And then, to show them what kind of Father he meant, he told a story about a man banging on a door in the middle of the night.

card.text: The man at the door was not asking for himself, and he was not too proud to look foolish. What would you ask God for tonight, if you knew for certain he was awake?
